Coram : T.S. THAKUR*, GYAN SUDHA MISRA
Constitution of India, 1950: A B Art. 226 - Writ petition - Challenging intra-departmental c communication proposing to consider re-a/location of lease area for mining iron ore - Held: High Court was in error in proceeding on an assumption that a final decision had been taken and in quashing what departmental communication constituting at best a step in the 0 process of taking a final decision by the Government - The writ petition in that view was pre-mature and ought to have been disposed of as such - Mines and minerals - Iron ore.
